mail/imap_message#

What a FETCH brought back about a message.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

for messages -> message {
    message.uid();
    if message.has_flags() { message.flags(); }
    if message.has_headers() { message.headers().first("Subject"); }
}

Description#

What a FETCH brought back about a message.

A FETCH may come unasked and may lack what was asked for: each part has a has_ check, and NIL is unavailable, never empty bytes. Bodies are the bytes fetched, not MIME-decoded.
